name: Experience the Energy - Adapting Futures
summary: "Experience the Energy - Adapting Futures" is an immersive VR experience that offers players an interactive journey through various roles in the energy industry. Participants are introduced to different job opportunities within the sector, ranging from renewable energy technicians to traditional oil and gas engineers.
